title: Xiaomi unveils its 3 nm XRING O3 SoC with LPDDR6 support and record AnTuTu performance

title: Valve celebrates 30 years transforming PC gaming with Half-Life, Steam, and Steam Deck
summary: The company founded by Gabe Newell commemorates three decades of innovation in video games and digital distribution.
